hero.headline: Hi, I'm a Marketing and Branding strategist blending creativity, strategy and business goals tastefully.
hero.subhead: With experience spanning Marketing and Product, I bring a multifaceted perspective on the table and help businesses be noticed and remembered.

journey.title: About Me
paragraphs: Learning is my default. I don't see myself in surroundings where I am not constantly evolving. I have always been drawn to extraordinary stories, unconventional approaches and tasteful visuals.

Besides my education rooted in media & communications, and early career in PR, I grew a liking to understanding the core of a business — Product. Figuring out how product decisions are tied to business outcomes provided a solid structure to my creativity. I frequently find myself applying this systems thinking and user empathy while crafting a marketing narrative.
